title: Sears reportedly preparing for bankruptcy filing as soon as this week
主要内容: Sears is reportedly preparing to file for bankruptcy as soon as this week, according to the Wall Street Journal. The filing would mark the culmination of years of efforts by CEO Eddie Lampert to keep the company afloat by steadily selling off assets. Lampert, who owns roughly 31% of Sears' shares, has been working with his hedge fund ESL Investments to restructure the company. Sears has hired M-III Partners to assist with the bankruptcy proceedings, and the company has also enlisted advisors like Lazard. Sears faces a $134 million debt payment due on October 15, which it may not be able to meet. Analysts suggest Sears would need to generate over $1 billion annually to remain operational, but its sales have been declining for years. The company's last profitable year was in 2010, and it burned through $1.8 billion in cash in 2017 alone. The failure to invest in stores and workers, as competitors like Walmart and Amazon expanded, has left Sears in a difficult position. Lampert has poured over $1 billion into the company, but without a rescue, Sears may still face bankruptcy. Sears currently operates approximately 900 Sears and Kmart stores, a significant decline from over 4,000 stores when it merged with Kmart in 2005. This would be a major assignment for boutique advisory firm M-III if it proceeds with the bankruptcy filing. Sears shares have fallen more than 80 percent this year, trading near 57 cents. The stock had previously reached a high of $195.18 in April 2007 and hit an all-time low of 56 cents earlier this week, reducing the company's market cap to $63.8 million.
